title: Meta Ads Agency Pricing by Industry: Published Ranges for 2026
summary: See Meta ads agency pricing by industry for ecommerce, B2B SaaS, apps and local businesses, with published minimums, fees and fit notes as of October 2026.
body_markdown:
## How do budgets change the quote?


Agencies quote against the budget they expect to manage, so a small test may be priced differently from a scaled account. Meta enforces[minimum budgets](https://www.facebook.com/business/help/203183363050448) that vary by country and objective, and Ads Manager shows an alert when a budget is below the minimum. The same page says that with a cost-per-result goal, your daily budget should be at least five times that goal.


Ask each agency which media budget its quote assumes, and whether its fee rises when spend crosses a threshold. A quote that looks cheap at a low spend can cost more at the level you plan to reach.


## What does a coach or course creator pay?


We did not find a published Meta agency price for coaches, course creators or other information-product sellers, so we do not list one. None of the providers above names that group: Hey Digital serves only B2B SaaS, Admiral names apps, games and ecommerce, and Hibu serves local businesses. Ask for a monthly fee, a setup charge and a media budget assumption in writing, then compare them with the figures above by scope.


## Why is Knowlify our pick if you want pricing you can plan around?


Several agencies above price by a percentage of media, so the fee moves with your spend. Knowlify's quote is scoped by the work instead: creative only, or end-to-end Meta campaign management. A person checks every ad, and the output is about 25 finished ads a week across AI UGC, 3D and character animation, and AI commercials, with the first batch on day 5. Media spend is separate, and there is no public rate card, so ask for a quote against your own industry and volume.


The guarantee limits the downside of a fee: where Knowlify runs the account, you don't pay for the month if an agreed target is missed after 30 days, and on creative-only plans, if the ads have not made more than you paid in the first 90 days, you can cancel by email for a full refund (terms on the[site](https://knowlify.com/meta-ads-agency#pricing) ). See the[Meta ads agency page](https://knowlify.com/meta-ads-agency) for the management option.


Pick another option when you need TikTok, LinkedIn, Google or YouTube ads, landing pages, or a specialist in one niche such as B2B SaaS. Knowlify runs Meta ads only and works remotely with US brands.


## Key takeaways


- Published Meta agency prices vary widely, from Darkroom's $1,500 a month plus media to NoGood's average retainer above $20,000.
- Percentage-of-spend fees with minimums change the bill as media grows, so calculate at today's spend and at the next level you plan to reach.
- B2B and SaaS providers price around pipeline and contract size, and several do not publish fees.
- Knowlify is our recommended route for finished ads, priced by custom quote, with campaign management optional.


## FAQ


### What does a Meta ads agency charge a SaaS company or for B2B lead generation?


Hey Digital works only with B2B SaaS, lists a 3 to 6 month commitment and does not publish its fee. NoGood says its average monthly retainer is above $20,000 and that it has no standardized packages. Ask each agency how it connects campaigns to CRM pipeline before you compare fees.


### How much do Meta agencies charge for app install campaigns?


Admiral Media works on Meta campaigns for apps, games and ecommerce brands, with a monthly retainer or a percentage of spend and no budget minimums. We did not find a published app-install price, so request a media and fee quote for the same app goal from each provider.


### What does a Meta agency charge a local service business?


Hibu sells custom local plans, with an implementation fee it does not publish and contracts that typically run 6 to 12 months. Chamber Media says it is difficult to grow on paid platforms when a local brand spends less than $5K. Knowlify quotes privately.


### What does a Meta agency charge a coach or course creator?


We did not find a published price for that group. Ask for the monthly fee, setup charge and assumed media budget in writing, and compare quotes by scope rather than by the monthly number alone.


### Is a percentage of spend cheaper than a flat fee?


It depends on your spend. Adside's 10% with a $3,500 minimum comes to $3,500 a month on $20,000 of media and $5,000 on $50,000, by our arithmetic. Calculate the bill at today's spend and at the next level you plan to reach, including any minimums.


### Does Knowlify publish a price list?


No. Knowlify publishes no rate card, and each quote is custom. Media spend is separate, and the quote covers either end-to-end Meta management or creative only.
